nodes.label: Generated Intelligence Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Generated intelligence outputs are supporting input only and must not become canonical docs, governance policy, or durable memory.

nodes.label: Project Template Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap initializes derived projects while avoiding mandatory language, runtime, or application stack assumptions.

nodes.label: Guides Layer
nodes.rationale: The guides layer turns stable technical behavior into workflows, tutorials, and references for humans, developers, users, and AI agents.

nodes.label: Lazy-Load Principle
nodes.rationale: Agents load only the rule files required for the active task, reducing unnecessary policy surface while preserving mandatory governance.

nodes.label: Cross-Layer Refactoring Gate
nodes.rationale: Cross-layer refactoring requires canonical SDLC anchors so architecture-impacting evolution is reviewed before execution.
